content:
carlos: FYI got an invoice from NimbusWorks (NW-5590) with no PO number on it. Total is $5,540. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/NW-5590.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice imported (inv_20240415_6123). Flag: missing_po. Routed to megan_fin by vendor default.

megan_fin: I don't own PO matching. Can procurement confirm if there's a PO and whether amount aligns? Also need GL guidance if we hold.

procurement-bot: Candidate PO 4412 for NimbusWorks found (committed $5,000). Three-way mismatch: invoice $5,540 vs PO $5,000. Tagging @priya_proc.

priya_proc: Taking this. Looks like $540 is a reconciling charge (bank fees) that vendor added at remittance. Ops need to confirm if bank fee was authorized or should be absorbed by vendor. @ops-liaison can you check payment terms/approval?

ops-liaison: No approval on file for ancillary bank fees. Terms in SOW indicate vendor to bear bank charges. Please HOLD payment and request corrected invoice or credit memo. GL: code base $5,000 to 6105-Contracted Svcs; hold $540 in suspense.

megan_fin: Marked invoice HOLD_INV_1975001123 in AP and added comment: "missing PO reference + $540 bank fee unapproved; procurement to request corrected invoice or credit memo."

carlos: I'll email AR at ar@nimbusworks.com asking for reissue referencing PO 4412 or credit memo for $540. If they refuse, we'll remit $5,000 and open a dispute for the remainder.

priya_proc: Agreed. Request sent. Target reply 24 hours. If no reply escalate to vendor manager. :email:

approvals-bot: Re-route complete. Audit reference audit_66421.

megan_fin: Thanks all — keep thread updated. If vendor provides corrected invoice, AP will schedule payment for full amount; otherwise partial release for PO amount only. :white_check_mark:
